failure_modes.name: Query_Form_Mismatch
failure_modes.evidence: Hop 2 query: 'Who was the cast of the 2016 film "The Land" and did Mark Cobb produce it? Did any actress from Death Race (2008) appear in The Land (2016)?' — This is a natural-language yes/no question with compound multi-part asks bundling several targets (cast identity, producer confirmation, cross-film appearance), rather than a well-formed query targeting specific entities.

failure_modes.name: Insufficient_Retrieved_Evidence
failure_modes.evidence: Summary 1 states: 'To complete verification, evidence documents would be needed regarding: - The Land (2016) - cast list and producer information - Mark Cobb - his filmography and producer credits'. Summary 2 states: 'What is missing: To verify this claim, the following evidence documents would be required: 1. **"The Land" (2016) - cast and production information**'. Hop 3 query targets 'The Land 2016' and 'Mark Cobb producer' explicitly but no document about the 2016 film 'The Land' was retrieved across any hop, indicating a corpus/retriever coverage gap.

failure_modes.name: Solver_Irrelevant_Passage_Overprocessing
failure_modes.evidence: Solver summary 2 provides detailed analysis of seven irrelevant passages from hop 2: 'Passage [1]: About Djibouti Olympics - irrelevant... Passage [2]: About "The Evil Divide" album by Death Angel metal band - irrelevant... Passage [5]: About "From the Land of the Moon" (2016 French film) - NOT "The Land" (2016) - irrelevant... Passage [7]: About Tuvalu at 2016 Olympics - irrelevant.' The solver spent resources cataloging and dismissing clearly off-topic Olympic and music content instead of focusing on the evidence gap.

failure_modes.name: Missing_Evidence_Not_Specified
failure_modes.evidence: Summary 1 states 'To complete verification, evidence documents would be needed regarding: - The Land (2016) - cast list and producer information - Mark Cobb - his filmography and producer credits - Connection between the Death Race actress and The Land (2016)' but never names which specific actress from Death Race (e.g., Joan Allen) needs to be verified in The Land. Both summaries fail to specify that Joan Allen is the actress whose appearance in The Land needs confirmation.
